about: ChoiceGroup — a question answered by choosing from a few options: radio buttons for one, checkboxes for any number. Use for: up to about seven options a reader should see all of at once. Don't use for

type.about: checkbox: any number of the options. radio: exactly one.

legend.about: The question the options answer. The group's name.

hint.about: Help that applies to the whole group, under the question.

error.about: What is wrong, when something is. Read with the question.

value.about: The chosen value (radio) or values (checkbox), when the caller keeps them.

defaultValue.about: The value or values chosen at first, when the component keeps its own.

onChange.about: Called with the new value (radio) or values (checkbox).

layout.about: Options one under another (default), or in a row, for two or three short ones ("Yes", "No").
